title: J.S. Bach - Toccata and Fugue in D minor BWV 565
summary: Organist Hans-Andre Stamm performs Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D minor, BWV 565, on the Trost organ in Waltershausen, Germany, an instrument from 1730. The video shows the playing and footwork.
why: Recommended as an expressive performance on a historically significant organ with good videography.

quote.text: Great videography, great organ and very expressive organist.
